nodes.name: SCRUM-116 implementation design
nodes.summary: Markdown document "SCRUM-116 implementation design" (specification, 7 lines): Use a governed control-plane plus target-runtime ownership topology. Keep package code in `DW-SuperApps/.dw/powers`, thin host routing in DW-SuperApps host adapters, GWC gate artifacts in `.gwc/tasks/<task-id>/`, and selected target generated outputs in `.ua`, `.task-me` and `.bmad` roots.

nodes.name: SCRUM-116 implementation requirements
nodes.summary: Markdown document "SCRUM-116 implementation requirements" (specification, 21 lines): Every generated artifact must resolve to exact source repository/ref/SHA, tool package/source commit, schema version, owner root and generation time.

nodes.name: SCRUM-116 implementation tasks
nodes.summary: Markdown document "SCRUM-116 implementation tasks" (specification, 10 lines): - [x] T1 Read exact protected-base plan and record G2 plan-read receipt. - [x] T2 Add topology/source-of-truth/ownership contract and denied-write rules. - [x] T3 Add provenance envelope schema and positive/rejected examples. - [x] T4 Add collision-control rules reusing
